ai_requirements.text: All AI processing containing customer order or personal data must strictly comply with GDPR and reside within designated European AWS regions.

ai_requirements.validation_reason: Target handle time reduction relies on AI summarization latency and zero hallucination tolerance for order status.
ai_requirements.text: Order status assistance must provide sub-second retrieval latency and absolute factual accuracy without hallucinating dispatch states.

use_cases.validation_reason: AI-assisted break triage is a recommended capability to streamline operator review.
use_cases.name: Automated Reconciliation Break Analysis and Triage
use_cases.description: Analyzes daily three-way reconciliation breaks between Shopify, SAP, and 3PL files to generate root-cause summaries and recommended corrective actions.
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Retrieves error logs, historical sequence numbers, and payload transaction histories from the operational database.
use_cases.orchestration: Event-driven workflow triggered post-reconciliation run via integration workflow orchestrator.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: Uses JSON schema output enforcement to generate structured break categories and action recommendations.
use_cases.evaluation: Evaluated against historical manual break reports for classification accuracy and explanation clarity.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Restricted to internal system logs without generating external notifications automatically.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Tracks operator acceptance rate of recommended break resolutions via Web Management Portal.
use_cases.human_review: All AI-recommended break resolutions require human confirmation before triggering system adjustments.
use_cases.data_privacy: System log payloads analyzed by AI are sanitized to strip personal data before model processing.

use_cases.validation_reason: Requires validation of agent workflow integration with Salesforce Service Cloud.
use_cases.name: Customer Service Order Context Summarizer
use_cases.description: Summarizes multi-system order lifecycle events and 3PL tracking updates for customer service agents in Salesforce.
use_cases.retrieval_notes: Retrieves order status, 3PL dispatch events, and return statuses across connected systems.
use_cases.orchestration: API Gateway-invoked microservice triggered on-demand by customer service agents.
use_cases.prompt_and_structured_output: Structured prompt templates returning bulleted status timelines and next-best-action guidance.
use_cases.evaluation: Monitored for summary conciseness and alignment with underlying system event logs.
use_cases.responsible_ai_safety: Guardrails filter out sensitive payment credentials and enforce read-only data access.
use_cases.monitoring_feedback: Monitors agent handle time metrics and explicit agent helpfulness ratings.
use_cases.human_review: Agents review the generated summary before taking customer-facing actions or initiating returns.
use_cases.data_privacy: Ensures personal data processing adheres to GDPR boundaries and avoids retention in model context buffers.

deterministic_areas.text: Core order routing, inventory ATP calculation, SFTP payload transformation, and payment settlement matching must remain strictly deterministic.
Sequence-gap detection, duplicate message identification, and initial three-way reconciliation matching logic must be executed by exact rule-based engines.

mandatory_human_decisions.text: Approving financial journal adjustments or inventory write-offs stemming from daily reconciliation breaks must be performed manually.
Authorizing high-value customer order refunds and overriding automated return rejections must remain a human operator decision.

architecture_pattern: Event-Driven Integration Architecture with AI-Assisted Operational Intelligence and Human-in-the-Loop Triage

provider_options.rationale: Provides managed, serverless access to high-performing foundation models with native AWS IAM and GDPR region compliance.
Offers low-latency structured output generation and native integration if GCP platform components are selected.
Provides model-agnostic abstraction for structured JSON output generation across cloud environments.

framework_recommendations.validation_reason: Framework selection should be confirmed by the delivery engineering team.
framework_recommendations.name: Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
framework_recommendations.purpose: Managed model invocation, prompt management, and guardrails for operational AI features within AWS.
framework_recommendations.rationale: Aligns with customer preference for AWS managed services and avoids maintaining dedicated orchestration infrastructure.

framework_recommendations.validation_reason: Requires validation against team language and serverless deployment preferences.
framework_recommendations.name: Custom orchestration
framework_recommendations.purpose: Lightweight, deterministic wrapping of model calls and JSON output validation within serverless integration functions.
framework_recommendations.rationale: Keeps operational footprint minimal and guarantees strict validation of structured summaries without full framework overhead.
